title: Learn to read offside.
help: Move with the joystick or WASD/arrows. Top: Switch; left: Pass in attack or Tackle in defence; right: Shoot. Keyboard: J pass, L tackle, K shoot, Tab switch. White ring: your player; yellow: receiver. Facing is retained when you release movement.
notice: First release · The yellow line is a reference: offside is not penalized yet. Rebounding boundaries; no fouls or restarts. Reach 7 goals or lead after 2 minutes to win. Draw: golden goal.
playing: Find space and build the play.
